methodology.runtime: Node pure rules simulation, no Browser or online claim
methodology.searchBudget: Existing Lv.4/Lv.5 node and depth caps; injected constant clock avoids load-dependent elapsed-time fallback. Four isolated workers. Decision elapsed telemetry is not wall-clock timing.
methodology.unresolvedPolicy: Keep existing Swiss engine one-point unresolved handling and FAIL status. Never replay with favorable seeds; no winner for unresolved playoffs.
methodology.population: Balanced designed roster; participation proportions are assigned, not observed external metagame share.
methodology.pairing: No rematches; repair greedy repeated pairs by a deterministic two-table exchange minimizing score distance, or stop if no exchange exists.
依積分分組、跨組浮動奇數組，優先避免重賽；同分以 deterministic seed 排序。
methodology.scoring: 勝 3 分、敗 0 分、卡住／無法完成以技術和各 1 分並標記 FAIL。
